_comment: Presence -> Home Assistant automations. Copy to presence-automations.json (gitignored) and set your real entity_ids. Each automation fires when a context EDGE matches its `on` (kind/label/transition). `approved:true` = fires on its own (act-low); anything else is draft-and-hold (ask-high). A `failsafe:true` automation is ALWAYS ask-high, no matter what. Nothing here runs until Home Assistant is configured (ha.env) AND the daemon integration is enabled — see HA_SETUP.md.
